title: O Lord, Whose Bounteous Hand Again
description: O Lord, Whose Bounteous Hand Again in Tonic Solfa to SELENA, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 291.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre, six lines (8.8.8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to SELENA; any other Long Metre, six lines tune fits them as well.
underlay: O Lord, whose boun-teous hand a-gain Hath poured Thy gifts in plen-ty down, Who all cre-a-tion dost sus-tain And all the earth with good-ness crown: Lord of the har-vest, here we own Our joy Thy gift, and Thine a-lone.

lines: O Lord, whose bounteous hand again
Hath poured Thy gifts in plenty down,
And all the earth with goodness crown:
Lord of the harvest, here we own
Our joy Thy gift, and Thine alone.
O may we ne’er with thankless heart
Forget from whom our blessings flow.
Still, Lord, Thy heavenly grace impart;
Still teach us what to Thee we owe.
Lord, may our lives with fruit divine
Return Thy care and prove us Thine.
Lord, grant that each may sow to Thee;
Grant us in endless life to reap.
Of every heart the Guardian be;
By day and night Thy servants keep
That all to Thee may joy afford
On Thy great harvest-day, O Lord.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1927.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to SELENA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
